text:
Ra.One is a sci-fi action film where the antagonist, Ra. One, is a supervillain player character with shapeshifting and mind-reading abilities, imbued with a self-learning AI. The story begins when Jenny Nair introduces a technology allowing digital world elements to enter the real world via wireless transmissions. Shekhar Subramaniam programs the game's protagonist, G. One, while Ra. One is faceless and substantially more powerful than G. One.
When the game launches, Ra. One escapes into the real world. G. One and Jenny attempt to bring G. One to life, but Ra. One pursues them. After G. One defeats Ra. One, he absorbs Ra. One's H.A.R.T., weakening the villain. The plot culminates with G. One and Prateek tricking Ra. One into shooting G. One without his H.A.R.T., leaving Ra. One helpless. Finally, G. One transports himself back to the digital world.
